variants.name: Copy Buffer to Screen

variants.asm_code:
push ds
push es
mov si,{BUFFER}
mov ax,0xa000
mov es,ax
xor di,di
mov cx,32000
cld

pop es

variants.name: Copy Screen to Buffer

variants.asm_code:
push ds
push es
mov ax,0xa000
mov ds,ax
xor si,si
push cs
pop es
mov di,{BUFFER}
mov cx,32000
cld
rep movsw
pop es
pop ds

variants.name: Blit Opaque Sprite

variants.name: Blit Transparent Sprite
variants.description: Draw a sprite while skipping a chosen transparent color.

variants.name: Draw Tile Map Cell

variants.description: Set one 6-bit RGB VGA palette entry.

variants.name: Read Pixel Color

variants.name: Draw Dotted Grid

variants.name: Draw Scanline Overlay
variants.description: Add evenly spaced horizontal scanlines for a retro effect.

variants.name: Mirror X Coordinate

mov ax,{SCREEN_WIDTH}
sub ax,[{X_VAR}]

variants.name: Mirror Y Coordinate

variants.asm_code:
mov ax,{SCREEN_HEIGHT}
sub ax,[{Y_VAR}]
dec ax

variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{Y_VAR}]
mov bx,320
mul bx
add ax,[{X_VAR}]
mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Draw GUI Window
variants.description: Draw a window body with border and title bar.

variants.name: Draw GUI Panel
variants.description: Draw a solid panel for grouping controls.

variants.name: Draw GUI Button
variants.description: Draw a raised two-tone button.

variants.name: Draw Pressed GUI Button
variants.description: Draw a darkened button in its pressed state.

variants.name: Draw GUI Text Box
variants.description: Draw a recessed text-entry field.

variants.name: Draw GUI Checkbox
variants.description: Draw a complete square checkbox outline.

variants.name: Draw Checked GUI Checkbox
variants.description: Draw a visible check mark inside a checkbox.

variants.name: Draw GUI Radio Button
variants.description: Draw a small radio-button indicator.

variants.name: Draw GUI Progress Bar
variants.description: Draw a progress bar from a current and maximum value.

variants.name: Draw GUI Slider Track
variants.description: Draw a horizontal slider track and movable thumb.

variants.name: Draw GUI Separator
variants.description: Draw a horizontal separator line.

variants.name: Draw GUI Menu Bar
variants.description: Draw a menu bar across the top of a window.

variants.name: Draw GUI Status Bar
variants.description: Draw a status bar along the bottom of a screen or window.

variants.name: Draw GUI Focus Rectangle
variants.description: Draw a dotted focus outline around the active control.

variants.name: Draw GUI Icon Background
variants.description: Draw a square icon tile background.

variants.name: GUI Rectangle Hit Test
variants.description: Set a result byte when a point lies inside a GUI rectangle.

variants.name: GUI Button Click Test
variants.description: Set a result byte when the pointer is inside a button and the left button is down.

variants.name: Clamp Pointer to Area
variants.description: Clamp pointer coordinates to a rectangular GUI area.

variants.name: Advance GUI Focus
variants.description: Move a focus index forward and wrap at the control count.

variants.name: Retreat GUI Focus
variants.description: Move a focus index backward with wrapping.

variants.name: Toggle GUI Boolean
variants.description: Toggle a checkbox-style byte between zero and one.
variants.asm_code: xor byte [{VALUE}],1

variants.name: Set GUI Theme Colors
variants.description: Define a reusable set of GUI color constants.

variants.name: Begin Game Loop
variants.description: Create a named main-loop label.
variants.asm_code: {LABEL}:

variants.name: End Game Loop
variants.description: Jump back to the main game-loop label.
variants.asm_code: jmp {LABEL}

variants.name: Wait for Vertical Retrace
variants.description: Wait for a VGA vertical retrace to reduce tearing.
variants.asm_code:
mov dx,0x03da
.wait_not_retrace_{ID}: in al,dx
test al,8
jnz .wait_not_retrace_{ID}
.wait_retrace_{ID}: in al,dx
test al,8
jz .wait_retrace_{ID}

variants.name: Increment Frame Counter
variants.description: Increment a 16-bit frame counter once per frame.
variants.asm_code: inc word [{COUNTER}]

variants.name: Reset Frame Counter
variants.description: Reset a frame counter to zero.
variants.asm_code: mov word [{COUNTER}],0

variants.name: Set Entity Position
variants.description: Set an entity's 16-bit X and Y position variables.
variants.asm_code:
mov word [{X_VAR}],{X}
mov word [{Y_VAR}],{Y}

variants.name: Move Entity by Velocity
variants.description: Add signed velocity variables to an entity position.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{VX_VAR}]
add [{X_VAR}],ax
mov ax,[{VY_VAR}]
add [{Y_VAR}],ax

variants.name: Apply Entity Gravity
variants.description: Add gravity to an entity's vertical velocity.
variants.asm_code: add word [{VY_VAR}],{GRAVITY}

variants.name: Apply Entity Friction
variants.description: Move a signed horizontal velocity toward zero.

variants.name: Clamp Entity to Screen
variants.description: Keep an entity inside screen bounds.

variants.name: Bounce Entity Horizontally
variants.description: Reverse horizontal velocity.
variants.asm_code: neg word [{VX_VAR}]

variants.name: Bounce Entity Vertically
variants.description: Reverse vertical velocity.
variants.asm_code: neg word [{VY_VAR}]

variants.name: AABB Collision Test
variants.description: Test two axis-aligned rectangles and write a boolean result.

variants.name: Point Collision Test
variants.description: Test whether a point is inside an axis-aligned rectangle.

variants.name: Reduce Entity Health
variants.description: Subtract damage and clamp health at zero.

variants.name: Heal Entity
variants.description: Add health and clamp to a maximum.

variants.name: Add Game Score
variants.description: Add points to a 16-bit score.
variants.asm_code: add word [{SCORE}],{POINTS}

variants.name: Lose a Life
variants.description: Decrease lives without underflowing below zero.
variants.asm_code:
cmp byte [{LIVES}],0
je .life_done_{ID}
dec byte [{LIVES}]
.life_done_{ID}:

variants.name: Advance Animation Frame
variants.description: Advance and wrap a sprite animation frame index.

variants.name: Calculate Sprite Frame Address
variants.description: Calculate a sprite-frame pointer from frame size and index.

variants.name: Follow Entity Camera
variants.description: Center a camera position on an entity with an offset.

variants.name: Clamp Game Camera
variants.description: Keep a camera inside world limits.

variants.name: Convert World to Screen
variants.description: Subtract the camera origin from world coordinates.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{WORLD_X}]
sub ax,[{CAMERA_X}]
mov [{SCREEN_X}],ax
mov ax,[{WORLD_Y}]
sub ax,[{CAMERA_Y}]
mov [{SCREEN_Y}],ax

variants.name: Convert Position to Tile
variants.description: Divide pixel coordinates by a power-of-two tile size.

variants.name: Calculate Tile Map Index
variants.description: Calculate row times map width plus column.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{ROW}]
mov bx,{MAP_WIDTH}
mul bx
add ax,[{COLUMN}]
mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Read Tile Value
variants.description: Read one tile byte using a calculated map index.
variants.asm_code:
mov bx,[{INDEX}]
mov al,[{MAP}+bx]
mov [{OUTPUT}],al

variants.name: Write Tile Value
variants.description: Write one tile byte using a calculated map index.
variants.asm_code:
mov bx,[{INDEX}]
mov byte [{MAP}+bx],{VALUE}

variants.name: Set Direction from Horizontal Input
variants.description: Set horizontal velocity from left and right input bytes.

variants.name: Set Direction from Vertical Input
variants.description: Set vertical velocity from up and down input bytes.

variants.name: Set Game State
variants.description: Store a numeric game-state value.
variants.asm_code: mov byte [{STATE}],{VALUE}

variants.name: Jump for Game State
variants.description: Jump to a label when the current game state matches.
variants.asm_code:
cmp byte [{STATE}],{VALUE}
je {LABEL}

variants.name: Start Cooldown
variants.description: Set a frame-based cooldown counter.
variants.asm_code: mov word [{COOLDOWN}],{FRAMES}

variants.name: Tick Cooldown
variants.description: Decrease a cooldown counter when it is above zero.
variants.asm_code:
cmp word [{COOLDOWN}],0
je .cooldown_done_{ID}
dec word [{COOLDOWN}]
.cooldown_done_{ID}:

variants.name: Cooldown Ready Test
variants.description: Write one when a cooldown counter has reached zero.
variants.asm_code:
mov byte [{RESULT}],0
cmp word [{COOLDOWN}],0
jne .ready_done_{ID}
mov byte [{RESULT}],1
.ready_done_{ID}:

variants.name: Initialize Mouse Driver
variants.description: Reset the mouse driver and save whether one is available.
variants.asm_code:
xor ax,ax
int 0x33
mov [{AVAILABLE}],ax

variants.name: Show Mouse Pointer
variants.description: Show the installed mouse-driver pointer.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,1
int 0x33

variants.name: Hide Mouse Pointer
variants.description: Hide the installed mouse-driver pointer.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,2
int 0x33

variants.name: Read Mouse State
variants.description: Read mouse buttons and coordinates into variables.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,3
int 0x33
shr cx,1
mov [{X_VAR}],cx
mov [{Y_VAR}],dx
mov [{BUTTONS}],bx

variants.name: Set Mouse Horizontal Range
variants.description: Constrain mouse X coordinates.

variants.name: Set Mouse Vertical Range
variants.description: Constrain mouse Y coordinates.

variants.name: Test Mouse Button
variants.description: Write one when the selected mouse-button mask is down.

variants.name: Clear Key State Array
variants.description: Clear a 128-byte keyboard state table.
variants.asm_code:
push es
push ds
pop es
mov di,{KEY_STATES}
xor ax,ax
mov cx,64
rep stosw
pop es

variants.name: Set Arrow Key State
variants.description: Map an arrow-key scan code to direction state bytes.

variants.name: Map WASD Key
variants.description: Map an ASCII WASD key in AL to direction state bytes.

variants.name: Convert Key to Uppercase
variants.description: Convert an ASCII lowercase key in a variable to uppercase.
variants.asm_code:
mov al,[{KEY}]
cmp al,'a'
jb .upper_done_{ID}
cmp al,'z'
ja .upper_done_{ID}
sub al,32
mov [{KEY}],al
.upper_done_{ID}:

variants.name: Convert Key to Lowercase
variants.description: Convert an ASCII uppercase key in a variable to lowercase.
variants.asm_code:
mov al,[{KEY}]
cmp al,'A'
jb .lower_done_{ID}
cmp al,'Z'
ja .lower_done_{ID}
add al,32
mov [{KEY}],al
.lower_done_{ID}:

variants.name: Append Key to Input Buffer
variants.description: Append AL to a bounded zero-terminated input buffer.
variants.asm_code:
mov bx,[{LENGTH}]
cmp bx,{MAX_LENGTH}
jae .append_done_{ID}
mov di,{BUFFER}
add di,bx
mov [di],al
inc di
inc bx
mov [{LENGTH}],bx
mov byte [di],0
.append_done_{ID}:

variants.name: Backspace Input Buffer
variants.description: Remove the final character from an input buffer.
variants.asm_code:
mov bx,[{LENGTH}]
or bx,bx
jz .backspace_done_{ID}
dec bx
mov [{LENGTH}],bx
mov byte [{BUFFER}+bx],0
.backspace_done_{ID}:

variants.name: Clear Input Buffer
variants.description: Reset a text-input buffer and its length.
variants.asm_code:
mov word [{LENGTH}],0
mov byte [{BUFFER}],0

variants.name: Clamp Byte Value
variants.description: Clamp an unsigned byte variable between minimum and maximum.

variants.name: Clamp Word Value
variants.description: Clamp an unsigned word variable between minimum and maximum.

variants.name: Absolute Word Value
variants.description: Store the absolute value of a signed word.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{INPUT}]
test ax,ax
jns .abs_done_{ID}
neg ax
.abs_done_{ID}: mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Minimum of Two Words
variants.description: Store the smaller of two unsigned words.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{LEFT}]
cmp ax,[{RIGHT}]
jbe .min_done_{ID}
mov ax,[{RIGHT}]
.min_done_{ID}: mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Maximum of Two Words
variants.description: Store the larger of two unsigned words.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{LEFT}]
cmp ax,[{RIGHT}]
jae .max_done_{ID}
mov ax,[{RIGHT}]
.max_done_{ID}: mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Integer Linear Interpolation
variants.description: Move a value toward a target by a numerator/denominator fraction.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{TARGET}]
sub ax,[{CURRENT}]
mov bx,{NUMERATOR}
imul bx
mov bx,{DENOMINATOR}
idiv bx
add ax,[{CURRENT}]
mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: 8.8 Fixed Point Multiply
variants.description: Multiply two signed 8.8 fixed-point values.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{LEFT}]
imul word [{RIGHT}]
mov bx,256
idiv bx
mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: 8.8 Fixed Point Divide
variants.description: Divide two signed 8.8 fixed-point values, returning zero for a zero divisor.
variants.asm_code:
mov bx,[{RIGHT}]
or bx,bx
jz .fixed_div_zero_{ID}
mov ax,[{LEFT}]
mov cx,256
imul cx
idiv bx
mov [{OUTPUT}],ax
jmp .fixed_div_done_{ID}
.fixed_div_zero_{ID}: mov word [{OUTPUT}],0
.fixed_div_done_{ID}:

variants.name: LCG Random Step
variants.description: Advance a compact 16-bit linear-congruential random generator.

variants.name: Random Range Word
variants.description: Map a 16-bit random seed to an inclusive range.

variants.name: Manhattan Distance
variants.description: Calculate absolute X distance plus absolute Y distance.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{AX_VAR}]
sub ax,[{BX_VAR}]
jns .man_x_{ID}
neg ax
.man_x_{ID}: mov cx,ax
mov ax,[{AY_VAR}]
sub ax,[{BY_VAR}]
jns .man_y_{ID}
neg ax
.man_y_{ID}: add ax,cx
mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Squared Distance
variants.description: Calculate dx squared plus dy squared without a square root.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{AX_VAR}]
sub ax,[{BX_VAR}]
imul ax
mov cx,ax
mov ax,[{AY_VAR}]
sub ax,[{BY_VAR}]
imul ax
add ax,cx
mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: 2D Dot Product
variants.description: Calculate the dot product of two 2D word vectors.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{AX_VAR}]
imul word [{BX_VAR}]
mov cx,ax
mov ax,[{AY_VAR}]
imul word [{BY_VAR}]
add ax,cx
mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Add 2D Vectors
variants.description: Add two pairs of signed word coordinates.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{AX_VAR}]
add ax,[{BX_VAR}]
mov [{OUT_X}],ax
mov ax,[{AY_VAR}]
add ax,[{BY_VAR}]
mov [{OUT_Y}],ax

variants.name: Subtract 2D Vectors
variants.description: Subtract one pair of signed word coordinates from another.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{AX_VAR}]
sub ax,[{BX_VAR}]
mov [{OUT_X}],ax
mov ax,[{AY_VAR}]
sub ax,[{BY_VAR}]
mov [{OUT_Y}],ax

variants.name: Wrap Word Value
variants.description: Wrap a word variable from maximum back to minimum.

variants.name: Calculate Percentage
variants.description: Calculate value times 100 divided by maximum.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{VALUE}]
mov bx,100
mul bx
mov bx,[{MAXIMUM}]
or bx,bx
jz .percent_zero_{ID}
div bx
jmp .percent_store_{ID}
.percent_zero_{ID}: xor ax,ax
.percent_store_{ID}: mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Map Word Range
variants.description: Map a word value from one numeric range to another.

variants.name: Rectangle Center Point
variants.description: Calculate the center coordinate of a rectangle.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{X_VAR}]
mov bx,{WIDTH}
shr bx,1
add ax,bx
mov [{CENTER_X}],ax
mov ax,[{Y_VAR}]
mov bx,{HEIGHT}
shr bx,1
add ax,bx
mov [{CENTER_Y}],ax

variants.name: Byte Average
variants.description: Average two unsigned byte variables without overflow.
variants.asm_code:
xor ax,ax
mov al,[{LEFT}]
xor bx,bx
mov bl,[{RIGHT}]
add ax,bx
shr ax,1
mov [{OUTPUT}],al

variants.name: Word Average
variants.description: Average two unsigned word variables without overflowing 16 bits.
variants.asm_code:
mov ax,[{LEFT}]
mov bx,[{RIGHT}]
mov cx,ax
and cx,bx
and cx,1
shr ax,1
shr bx,1
add ax,bx
add ax,cx
mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Clear String Buffer
variants.description: Zero-fill a fixed-size string buffer.
variants.asm_code:
push es
push ds
pop es
mov di,{BUFFER}
xor ax,ax
mov cx,{SIZE}
rep stosb
pop es

variants.name: Append Character to String
variants.description: Append a character to a zero-terminated string using a length word.
variants.asm_code:
mov bx,[{LENGTH}]
mov di,{BUFFER}
add di,bx
mov al,{CHARACTER}
mov [di],al
inc di
mov byte [di],0
inc word [{LENGTH}]

variants.name: Remove Last String Character
variants.description: Remove the final character from a bounded string.
variants.asm_code:
mov bx,[{LENGTH}]
or bx,bx
jz .remove_done_{ID}
dec bx
mov [{LENGTH}],bx
mov byte [{BUFFER}+bx],0
.remove_done_{ID}:

variants.name: Compare Strings
variants.description: Compare two zero-terminated strings and write a boolean result.

variants.name: Uppercase String
variants.description: Convert ASCII lowercase letters in a string to uppercase.

variants.name: Lowercase String
variants.description: Convert ASCII uppercase letters in a string to lowercase.

variants.name: Reverse String
variants.description: Reverse a zero-terminated string in place using its length.
variants.asm_code:
mov si,{STRING}
mov di,{STRING}
add di,[{LENGTH}]
dec di
mov cx,[{LENGTH}]
shr cx,1
.reverse_{ID}: mov al,[si]
xchg al,[di]
mov [si],al
inc si
dec di
loop .reverse_{ID}

variants.name: Parse Unsigned Decimal
variants.description: Parse a decimal string into a 16-bit word.
variants.asm_code:
mov si,{STRING}
xor ax,ax
.parse_dec_{ID}: mov bl,[si]
or bl,bl
jz .parse_dec_done_{ID}
cmp bl,'0'
jb .parse_dec_done_{ID}
cmp bl,'9'
ja .parse_dec_done_{ID}
sub bl,'0'
xor bh,bh
mov dx,10
mul dx
add ax,bx
inc si
jmp .parse_dec_{ID}
.parse_dec_done_{ID}: mov [{OUTPUT}],ax

variants.name: Define Byte Array
variants.description: Define a named byte array with an initial fill value.

variants.name: Define Word Array
variants.description: Define a named word array with an initial fill value.

variants.name: Write Word Array Item
variants.description: Write a value into an indexed word-array element.

variants.name: Sum Byte Array

variants.name: Find Byte in Array
variants.description: Find the first matching byte and return its index or 0xffff.

variants.name: Maximum Byte in Array
variants.description: Find the largest unsigned byte in an array.

variants.name: Minimum Byte in Array
variants.description: Find the smallest unsigned byte in an array.

variants.description: Reset ring-buffer head, tail, and count words.

mov word [{TAIL}],0
mov word [{COUNT}],0

variants.name: Push Ring Buffer Byte
variants.description: Push a byte into a bounded ring buffer when space is available.

variants.name: Pop Ring Buffer Byte
variants.description: Pop the oldest byte from a ring buffer when available.
variants.asm_code:
mov byte [{AVAILABLE}],0
cmp word [{COUNT}],0
je .queue_pop_done_{ID}
mov bx,[{HEAD}]
mov al,[{BUFFER}+bx]

inc bx
cmp bx,{CAPACITY}
jb .queue_head_ok_{ID}
xor bx,bx

dec word [{COUNT}]
mov byte [{AVAILABLE}],1
